votes.motion: Commissioner Swanson moved to forward a POSITIVE recommendation to the City Council for the Text Amendment, Application 2024-29, based on the following Findings: 3 BLUFFDALE CITY PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES Wednesday, October 16, 2024 1. The proposed amendments address consistency across most commercial zones and allow the property owners, developers, and designers flexibility to address unique problems and ownership scenarios. 2. The Bluffdale City Code adequately addresses minimum requirements and lot standards through the Site Plan review process and adopted building codes
